arxiv-2203-04667.title: Curvatures on homogeneous Finsler spaces
arxiv-2203-04667.creator: Gauree Shanker, Seema Jangir, Jaspreet Kaur
arxiv-2203-04667.description: Abstract Abstract The main aim of this article is to calculate explicit formula for S-curvature in homogeneous generalized m -Kropina metric. Further, we also deduce mean Berwald curvature for homogeneous generalized m -Kropina metric from S-curvature. Mathematics Subject Classification: 53C30; 53C60 Keywords and Phrases: Homogeneous Finsler space, S-curvature, mean Berwald curvature, generalized m -Kropina metric.

arxiv-2208-05959.title: Future prospects on testing extensions to Λ \Lambda CDM through the weak lensing of gravitational waves
arxiv-2208-05959.creator: Charlie T. Mpetha 1, Giuseppe Congedo 1, Andy Taylor 1
arxiv-2208-05959.description: Abstract With planned space-based and 3 rd generation ground-based gravitational wave detectors (LISA, Einstein Telescope, Cosmic Explorer), and proposed DeciHz detectors (DECIGO, Big Bang Observer), it is timely to explore statistical cosmological tests that can be employed with the forthcoming plethora of data, 10 4 − 10 6 10^{4}-10^{6} mergers a year.

arxiv-2306-11588.title: Cosmological coupling of nonsingular black holes
arxiv-2306-11588.creator: and M. Branchesi
arxiv-2306-11588.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by and M. Branchesi. We show that – in the framework of general relativity (GR) – if black holes (BHs) are singularity-free objects, they couple to the large-scale cosmological dynamics. We find that the leading contribution to the resulting growth of the BH mass ( M BH M_{\rm BH} ) as a function of the scale factor a a stems from the curvature term, yielding M BH ∝ a k M_{\rm BH}\propto a^{k} , with k = 1 k=1 .

arxiv-2510-03360.title: Physics-informed Neural-operator Predictive Control for Drag Reduction in Turbulent Flows
arxiv-2510-03360.creator: Zelin Zhao, Zongyi Li, Kimia Hassibi, Kamyar Azizzadenesheli, Junchi Yan, H. Jane Bae, Di Zhou, Anima Anandkumar
arxiv-2510-03360.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zelin Zhao, Zongyi Li, Kimia Hassibi, Kamyar Azizzadenesheli, Junchi Yan, H. Jane Bae, Di Zhou, Anima Anandkumar. Assessing turbulence control effects for wall friction numerically is a significant challenge since it requires expensive simulations of turbulent fluid dynamics. We instead propose an efficient deep reinforcement learning (RL) framework for modeling and control of turbulent flows.

pmc-10541873.title: Second breast cancer: recurrence score results, clinicopathologic characteristics, adjuvant treatments, and outcomes—exploratory analysis of the Clalit registry
pmc-10541873.creator: Shlomit S. Shachar, Michelle Leviov, Rinat Yerushalmi, Karen Drumea, Margarita Tokar, Lior Soussan-Gutman, Avital Bareket-Samish, Amir Sonnenblick, Noa Ben-Baruch, Ella Evron, Einav Nili Gal-Yam, Shani Paluch-Shimon, Gil Bar-Sela, Hadar Goldvaser, Salomon M. Stemmer
pmc-10541873.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Data on using the 21-gene Recurrence Score (RS) testing on second breast cancer (BC; second primary or local recurrence) are lacking. This cohort study examined patients with first and second BC, who underwent 21-gene testing both times. It included a ‘study-cohort’ (60 N0/N1mi/N1 ER + HER2‒ BC patients with ≥2 RS results >1 year apart) and a ‘general 21-gene-tested BC-cohort’ (2044 previously described N0/N1mi/N1 patients).

pmc-11270958.title: Swinepox virus: an unusual outbreak in free-range pig farms in Sicily (Italy)
pmc-11270958.creator: Vincenzo Di Marco Lo Presti, Dorotea Ippolito, Giusy Cardeti, Antonella Cersini, Luigi Bertolotti, Benedetta Amato, Barbara Colitti, Chiara Giudice, Flavia Pruiti Ciarello, Domenico Vicari, Maria Teresa Scicluna, Maria Teresa Capucchio, Rosita Calogero, Michele Fiasconaro
pmc-11270958.description: BackgroundTwo outbreaks of swinepox were investigated in free-range domestic pig farms located in the northeastern side of Sicily, Italy. The disease is generally self-limiting with a low mortality rate, but morbidity can reach high rates in case of poor sanitary conditions, improper husbandry practices and ectoparasitic infestation.

pmc-11547463.title: Experimental Research on the Performance of Recycled Waste Concrete Powder (RWCP) on Concrete
pmc-11547463.creator: Shuai Wang, Aixun Wang, Xudong Fu, Xianwei Zhang, Zhe Li, Yongjun Guo, Shenghao Li, Mingzhao Wang
pmc-11547463.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Waste concrete is a large amount of solid waste produced in the process of urban construction and renewal in China. Its resource utilization is of great significance for saving mineral resources and improving urban environmental quality. The present study was designed to investigate the effects of mechanical grinding time on the particle size distribution and activity of recycled waste concrete powder (RWCP).

pmc-11673775.title: Low-Intensity Continuous Ultrasound Enhances the Therapeutic Efficacy of Curcumin-Encapsulated Exosomes Derived from Hypoxic Liver Cancer Cells via Homotropic Drug Delivery Systems
pmc-11673775.creator: MinSeok Kim, YounJoong Kim, ChiYeon Hwang, MinHyeok Song, SuKang Kim, Kyung-Sik Yoon, InSug Kang, HyungHwan Baik, Yong-Jin Yoon
pmc-11673775.description: Exosomes are extracellular nanovesicles secreted by cells that efficiently deliver therapeutic cargo for cancer treatment. However, because exosomes are present in low quantities and have limited target specificity, internal and external stress stimulation has been studied to increase exosome efficiency. Inspired by these studies, the uptake efficiency of cobalt chloride-induced hypoxic cancer cell-secreted exosomes was evaluated.

pmc-12474025.title: Effects of Nitrogen and Phosphorus on Estuarine Phytoplankton Communities in Aquatic Microcosms
pmc-12474025.creator: Jianan Ling, Chao Wei, Dongning Yang, Jiangning Zeng, Fangping Cheng, Xin Zheng, Zhanhong Yang, Antonia Concetta Elia
pmc-12474025.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Phytoplankton serves as the primary producer in estuarine ecosystems, with its community structure and dynamics being directly influenced by the concentration and ratio of nitrogen (N) and phosphorus (P) nutrients. This study utilized raw water from the Yangtze Estuary to establish a series of ocean microcosm systems, setting up gradients of dissolved inorganic nitrogen (DIN) and reactive phosphate (SRP) concentrations to explore the reaction of phytoplankton communities over 30 days.

pmc-12603902.title: Comprehensive analysis of antimony-based organic–inorganic hybrid material: phase transition, Raman scattering, and the electrical conduction mechanism of [(CH3)4P]3Sb2Br9
pmc-12603902.creator: Khaoula Ben Brahim, Arafat Ghoudi, Ines Mbarek, Noweir Ahmad Alghamdi, Malika Ben Gzaiel, Abderrazek Oueslati
pmc-12603902.description: The present work focuses on elucidating the origin of the phase transition in [(CH3)4P]3Sb2Br9 and its associated electrical properties. The compound was synthesized by slow solvent evaporation at constant temperature and characterized using X-ray powder diffraction, FTIR spectroscopy, temperature-dependent Raman spectroscopy, and impedance spectroscopy. XRD confirmed the formation of a monoclinic structure with the polar P31c space group.

pmc-12694014.title: Monocular Visual Measurement System Uncertainty Analysis and One-Step End–End Estimation Upgrade
pmc-12694014.creator: Kuai Zhou, Wenmin Chu, Peng Zhao
pmc-12694014.description: Monocular visual measurement and vision-guided robotics technology find extensive application in modern automated manufacturing, particularly in aerospace assembly. However, during assembly pose measurement and guidance, the propagation and accumulation of multi-source errors—including those from visual measurement, hand–eye calibration, and robot calibration—impact final assembly accuracy.

pmc-13313105.title: Late‐Onset Rheumatoid Arthritis and Air Pollution in a Multiethnic Cohort
pmc-13313105.creator: Anna H Wu, Chiuchen Tseng, Song‐Yi Park, Daniel O Stram, Kami White, Jun Wu, Cheryl Vigen, Veronica W Setiawan, Xian Yu, Steven Gazal, Christopher Haiman, Lynne Wilkens, Loïc Le Marchand, Iona Cheng, William Stohl
pmc-13313105.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the effects of ambient air pollution on rheumatoid arthritis (RA) incidence in a racially and ethnically diverse population.MethodsThis analysis included 42,152 California Multiethnic Cohort participants, aged ≥65 years (>70% African American and Latino adults) who were enrolled in the Fee For Service component of Medicare (2001–2018).
